task: independent sixth Blueprint characteristic: mathematical workflow
problem: Make exploration, condition checking, reuse, dependency inspection, computation and communication readable as one mathematical workflow.
proof_idea: A positive Newton update preserves positivity; x²=2 implies x=2/x, so the update fixes x. A second file cites the named theorem.

litex_code.library:
claim:
    ? forall x R+:
        (x + 2 / x) / 2 $in R+
    2 / x > 0
    x + 2 / x > 0
    (x + 2 / x) / 2 > 0

have fn newton_sqrt_two(x R+) R+ = (x + 2 / x) / 2

thm fixed_point:
    ? forall x R+:
        x^2 = 2
        =>:
            newton_sqrt_two(x) = x
    x = x * x / x = x^2 / x = 2 / x
    newton_sqrt_two(x) = (x + 2 / x) / 2 = (x + x) / 2 = x
litex_code.consumer:
release obj def newton::newton_sqrt_two
by thm newton::fixed_point(sqrt(2)) => newton::newton_sqrt_two(sqrt(2)) = sqrt(2)
litex_code.extraction:
claim:
    ? forall x R+:
        (x + 2 / x) / 2 $in R+
    2 / x > 0
    x + 2 / x > 0
    (x + 2 / x) / 2 > 0

have fn newton_sqrt_two(x R+) R+ = (x + 2 / x) / 2

# [-extract]
algo newton_sqrt_two_step(x R) R by cases:
    case x = 0: 1
    case x != 0: (x + 2 / x) / 2
# [end of -extract]

claim:
    ? forall x R+:
        newton_sqrt_two_step(x) = newton_sqrt_two(x)
    newton_sqrt_two_step(x) = (x + 2 / x) / 2 = newton_sqrt_two(x)
